title.notes: Title limit of 75 characters for most categories, effective July 27, 2026.

item_highlights.notes: Short highlight line shown near the title. Must not repeat the title.

search_terms.notes: Backend search terms, measured in UTF-8 bytes. Separate with spaces, no commas needed.

style_rules: Start the title with the brand (if provided) and the product type, then the most important feature.
Capitalize the first letter of each major word in the title; do not use ALL CAPS.
Do not put promotional words (sale, free shipping, best seller) anywhere in the listing.
Each bullet starts with a short benefit phrase in caps-free Title Case followed by a colon, then the detail.
Do not repeat words from the title in the backend search terms; no competitor brand names, no ASINs.
Do not use emojis, HTML, or special symbols such as ®, ™, ©, ! or $ in the title.
Write the description as short, readable paragraphs focused on use cases.
amazon_us.note: Verify in Seller Central before launch. Limits change and some categories have their own rules.

item_highlights.notes: Not used on TikTok Shop. Leave empty.

bullets.notes: TikTok has no bullet field; these 5 selling points are placed at the top of the description.

search_terms.notes: Keywords for hashtags and search optimization; keep it short.

style_rules: Write in a friendly, conversational tone that matches short-video shoppers.
Lead the title with the product type and the main use case; keep it within 50-80 characters when possible.
No emojis, and no special symbols such as ®, ™, ©, or decorative characters anywhere.
No promotional or urgency words (limited time, sale, free shipping, buy now).
Describe real use scenes (commute, gym, office) only if the seller's facts support them.
Keep sentences short and easy to scan on a phone.
tiktok_us.note: Verify in Seller Central before launch. Limits change and some categories have their own rules.
